priorStatuses.title: Handle missing cache entries before trimming

findings.title: [P1] Stop writing issued tokens to process logs
findings.body: Calling `recordIssuedToken` with a real authentication token writes the raw bearer credential to stdout. In environments that collect or expose application logs, anyone with log access can reuse the token until it expires.

findings.title: [P2] Restrict the post-login redirect to trusted destinations
findings.body: finishLogin now passes its unrestricted string argument directly to location.assign, replacing the fixed same-origin destination. A return URL derived from login state or request parameters can therefore send users to an attacker-controlled origin after authentication, enabling open-redirect phishing. Parse and allow only approved same-origin paths or hosts before navigating.
